title: Reading survey
prompt: The readings are 6, 11, 3, 14 and 9. Print how many of them exceed five, then on the next line the highest reading of all.

title: Under the limit
prompt: From the batch 9, 2, 12, 5 and 16, keep every entry under ten. Print each kept entry on its own line, then print how many you kept.

title: Odds doubled, evens summed
prompt: Walk the list 7, 4, 9, 10 in order. Print each odd entry doubled on its own line; after the walk print the total of the even entries.
